title: Sanjeev Arora case: ED conducts fresh raids in Punjab, Uttar Pradesh
summary: Sanjeev Arora was arrested by the Central agency last month following day-long searches at his official residence in Chandigarh

title: Five-day BRICS meeting begins in Indore to discuss global issues in agriculture sector
summary: As part of this conference, the Agriculture Working Group will hold deliberations till June 11 with officials from member countries

title: Foreigners who returned after voting in T.N. Assembly election come under the scanner
summary: Central and State law-enforcement agencies are working with the Election Commission of India to obtain data on foreign nationals who might have voted. Investigators have sought the assistance of the Bureau of Immigration in identifying foreign nationals who arrived in the State ahead of the election and departed within two to three days of polling

title: Notorious thief ‘Kozhi Paulose’ arrested by Thrissur Rural police
summary: 68-year-old is accused of thefts in nearly 100 places of worship across Thrissur and Ernakulam in Kerala

title: Monsoon enters South Konkan, State advises farmers to defer sowing
summary: The Agriculture and Disaster Management Department has forecast rainfall in parts of Sindhudurg and Ratnagiri districts until June 9; in other regions of Maharashtra, the monsoon’s progress and rainfall intensity are expected to remain low over the next week.

title: Consensual pre-marital relationship is not a blot on character, says Supreme Court
summary: The top court observes that premarital relationships are common in contemporary society and cannot be used as a pretext to cast aspersions on a person’s character

title: Kumaraswamy announces ₹25 lakh and a job for kin of Visakhapatnam steel plant blast victims
summary: The Steel Minister visits RINL and the hospital, orders an independent inquiry, and announces jobs and aid for the families of the dead and the injured

title: Patna Court stays arrest of ‘Khan Sir’
summary: The Court also reserved order on the bail plea of Raushan Anand, the rival coaching institute owner and teacher who was earlier arrested in the case
